lesson.name: Event Boundary Segmentation
lesson.problem: Persistence or gain retention measured before a scheduled high-impact macro release can become semantically invalid after the release because the market regime may reset.
lesson.action: Segment observations PRE_EVENT / EVENT_WINDOW / POST_EVENT and require post-event reconfirmation before carrying continuation confidence across the boundary.
